We’re building a distributed data pipeline platform engineered from the ground up in Rust, delivering unparalleled performance and reliability for demanding AI workloads. Current data pipelines struggle with scalability, latency, and operational complexity – leading to bottlenecks in model training and deployment. SynapseFlow solves this by leveraging a novel architecture inspired by high-frequency trading systems, ensuring data flows seamlessly and efficiently, even at massive scale. We're targeting data science teams at Series B/C AI companies and research institutions facing challenges with real-time data ingestion, transformation, and feature engineering. We’ve already secured early traction with two pilot customers demonstrating a 3x improvement in pipeline throughput compared to existing solutions. We're currently raising a $3M seed round to expand our engineering team and accelerate product development. I’m actively seeking connections with investors who understand the intricacies of infrastructure software and the rapidly evolving landscape of machine learning. Specifically, I'm looking to connect with partners who can offer not only capital, but also strategic guidance and access to potential customers. Let's talk if you're passionate about building the future of AI infrastructure.
